raw: BEGIN AVERAGING AND ANALYSIS OF THE SENSOR TIME SERIES DATA FOR MORE ACCURATE STABILITY AND RELIABILITY ESTIMATES. THIS TASK WILL HELP US UNDERSTAND IF ANY OUTLIERS ARE PRESENT OR IF THERE IS AN EVIDENCE OF TEMPORAL VARIATION. WITH THESE FINDINGS, WE CAN OPTIMIZE OUR TESTING PROCEDURES TO MAINTAIN HIGH QUALITY DATA COLLECTION.
